prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Software Development Engineer
Responsibilities: • Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable software solutions to meet the needs of the business. • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code. • Help integrate and maintain the code with hardware. • Ensure the efficiency and maintainability of the codebase. • Debug and troubleshoot software issues and implement bug fixes. • Continuously learn new technologies and programming languages to stay up-to-date with industry trends • Work with other engineers and cross-functional teams, including product management and design, to understand user requirements and design specifications. Requirements: • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field • Experience with RTOS. • Experience in software development, web platform development or mobile application development. • Expertise in at least one major programming language such as Python, Java, or C++, React Native. • Experience with Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano or similar development boards. • Experience with encryptions, NFC and BLE is desirable. • Experience with OpenCV and Computer Vision. • Strong understanding of software development principles and design patterns • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills • Ability to work in a fast
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working software developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications and full-stack solutions. I’m excited to apply for this Software Development Engineer role because I enjoy solving complex problems, writing clean and maintainable code, and working closely with teams to turn product requirements into reliable software.

My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’m comfortable working across the full stack, from building responsive front-end interfaces to designing backend services and data flows that are efficient, scalable, and easy to maintain. I place a strong emphasis on code quality, documentation, and long-term maintainability, which aligns well with your need for high-quality software solutions.

I’m also accustomed to debugging and troubleshooting issues methodically, identifying root causes, and implementing practical fixes that improve stability and performance. I value collaboration and communication, and I’m comfortable working with engineers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements, refine specifications, and deliver solutions that fit both technical and business needs.

While my core experience is in web development, I’m always eager to learn new technologies and expand my skill set to meet the needs of a project. I understand the importance of strong software development principles and thoughtful design patterns, especially when building systems that need to remain efficient and maintainable over time.

I’d welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team and bring a dependable, detail-oriented approach to development. I’m confident that my full-stack experience, problem-solving mindset, and commitment to quality would make me a strong fit for this role.
